svg.title: Gantry desktop workspace — middle-pane detail study, not implemented
svg.desc: Follow-up to desktop-workspace.svg. The sandbox list carries state pills, allocation with a restart flag, a traffic trend and feature icons; below it, the selected sandbox shows network throughput and destinations. All names, rates and records are sample data.
svg.text: Put the middle pane to work.
Rows carry live signal. The space under the list shows what the selected sandbox is doing.

svg.text: State pills, restart flags, traffic trends, and feature icons.
Network, Ports, Mounts, Secrets, MCP, and Audit for one sandbox.
Rates are deltas of byte counters every 3 s. No usage gauges.
LAYOUT STUDY ONLY — follows desktop-workspace.svg. Throughput history is session-only, like Activity, and resets on reconnect.
